heldout_PR_cohorts.take: first 4 created-ascending results per repo, irrespective of merged/open/closed status; if fewer, take all and report shortage; no alternate top-up; lock PR IDs before opening PR titles/bodies/diffs

prospective_rules.route PathValue: Chi strict better for bounded one client-adapter operation
prospective_rules.request context post-return, no snapshot: Gorilla advantage in prior bounded original-source test

heldout_PR_cohorts.thresholds: Require >=2 unseen, non-doc, source-admissible, independently clustered demands and >=30 percent coverage among such demands; otherwise UNDERPOWERED/LOW_COVERAGE. No forced global ranking. Report selective accuracy separately from coverage.
heldout_PR_cohorts.timepoint: t0 source/PR-submission variables only; t1 review-progress additionally has review information observed by t1; t2 final merged/closed outcome is only a label.
heldout_PR_cohorts.original_go_JS_cases: Native 2024 Chi/Gorilla and original JS event systems tested in R11-P7/P8; not evidence all future requested features are supported.
heldout_PR_cohorts.rival: Source-aware costed classic LTS, classical conditional contextual refinement and real options, CCR2/Iris/DimSum/Simuliris literature; equal observational/rights data.
